preferredStrategy: Relaunch toolbox-first: put real browser-local utilities in the first viewport, explain each job in plain language, and keep reproducible field tests and methodology as a secondary evidence layer. Do not begin with a newsletter. Start email only after the site earns explicit new consent and a sustainable named editorial owner. Contextter receives no automatic coverage, promotion, or winner status.

Toolbox plus a low-cadence field-test archive after independent review exists
Park or sell if the tools cannot be maintained and no independent developer audience emerges
productAssets: Browser-local SHA-256 Hash Generator with optional JSON receipt
